verdict.rationale: Weave's built-in and custom 'signals' automatically capture and classify agent interactions, and custom signals can tag production turns, with alerts routed to Slack or webhooks. Together these amount to continuous classification of live traffic, though the evidence is mostly marketing-level. The documented evaluation workflow centres on Dataset-based Evaluation objects, and guardrail scorers and testing against production traces are described without explicit continuous online-scoring mechanics. Missing for 10: documented configuration for running arbitrary scorers/LLM judges continuously on incoming production calls (sampling, filters, scheduling), in-depth first-party docs for signals as online evaluators, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
